Hunt - Beaconing via Fixed Interval Conn.description: Proactively hunt for C2 beaconing by detecting outbound connections firing at suspiciously regular intervals.

commands.description: Detect connections to same external IP with low standard deviation in timing (beaconing).
commands.command:
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceAction == "allow" and DestinationIP !startswith "10." and DestinationIP !startswith "172.16." and DestinationIP !startswith "192.168."
| summarize count(), stdev(toreal(todatetime(TimeGenerated) / 1m)) as jitter by SourceIP, DestinationIP
| where count_ > 20 and jitter < 2
| sort by jitter asc

commands.description: Hunt for processes making repetitive outbound connections at fixed sleep intervals.
commands.command:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| summarize connection_times = make_list(TimeGenerated), count() by DeviceName, RemoteIP, InitiatingProcessFileName
| where count_ > 15
| extend intervals = series_diff(connection_times)
| extend stdev_interval = stdev(intervals)
| where stdev_interval < 5

Hunt - Beaconing via Fixed Interval Conn.tuning: Start with connections at exact 60s, 120s, 300s intervals — most C2 default sleep timers. Add jitter detection (connections within 5% of a fixed interval). Whitelist legitimate heartbeat services.

Hunt - DNS Tunneling.description: Proactively hunt for data exfiltration or C2 channels over DNS.

commands.description: Detect high volume of unique DNS queries per registered domain (tunneling indicator).
commands.command:
DnsEvents
| where SubType == "LookupQuery"
| extend registered_domain = tostring(split(Name, ".")[-2]) + "." + tostring(split(Name, ".")[-1])
| summarize unique_subdomains = dcount(Name), query_count = count() by ClientIP, registered_domain
| where unique_subdomains > 80
| sort by unique_subdomains desc

commands.description: Hunt for abnormally long DNS query names (>50 chars) — base64 tunneling.
commands.command:
DnsEvents
| where strlen(Name) > 50
| where QueryType in ("A","TXT","CNAME","MX")
| summarize count() by ClientIP, Name
| sort by count_ desc

commands.description: High volume of TXT record queries — iodine, dnscat2 pattern.
commands.command:
DnsEvents
| where QueryType == "TXT"
| summarize count() by ClientIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 30
| sort by count_ desc

commands.description: Detect DNS NXDOMAIN flood — DGA domain generation algorithm activity.
commands.command:
DnsEvents
| where ResultCode == 3
| summarize nxdomain_count = count(), domains = make_set(Name) by ClientIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where nxdomain_count > 50
| sort by nxdomain_count desc

Hunt - DNS Tunneling.tuning: High entropy DNS labels (>3.5 entropy) with FQDN length >52 characters are strong indicators. Exclude CDN subdomains and certificate transparency logs. Alert on >100 unique subdomains per parent domain per hour.

Hunt - Impossible Travel & Anomalous Log.description: Proactively hunt for impossible travel, off-hours access, and anomalous sign-in patterns in Azure AD.

commands.description: Detect sign-ins from two different countries within 1 hour for the same user.
commands.command:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize locations = make_set(Location), ips = make_set(IPAddress), count() by UserPrincipalName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where array_length(locations) > 1
| sort by count_ desc

commands.description: Sign-in from previously unseen country for the user.
commands.command:
let known_countries = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d) and ResultType == 0
| summarize known = make_set(Location) by UserPrincipalName;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) and ResultType == 0
| join kind=leftouter known_countries on UserPrincipalName
| where Location !in (known)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, Location, IPAddress, AppDisplayName

commands.description: Sign-in outside business hours (before 06:00 or after 22:00 UTC).
commands.command:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == 0
| extend hour = hourofday(TimeGenerated)
| where hour < 6 or hour > 22
| where UserType != "Guest"
| summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, Location, AppDisplayName
| sort by count_ desc

commands.description: Legacy authentication protocol sign-ins (MFA bypass risk).
commands.command:
SigninLogs
| where ClientAppUsed in ("Exchange ActiveSync","IMAP4","MAPI","SMTP","POP3","Other clients")
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, ClientAppUsed, IPAddress
| sort by count_ desc

Hunt - Impossible Travel & Anomalous Log.tuning: Adjust travel speed threshold (500 mph for standard accounts). Whitelist known VPN exit nodes and cloud providers. Alert on velocity > speed of light (0ms between geos) as definitive indicator.

Hunt - Privileged Identity & Role Abuse.description: Proactively hunt for unauthorized privilege escalation and role assignments in Azure AD.

commands.description: Global Administrator or Privileged Role Administrator assigned.
commands.command:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName == "Add member to role"
| where TargetResources has_any ("Global Administrator","Privileged Role Administrator","Security Administrator","Exchange Administrator")
| project TimeGenerated, InitiatedBy, TargetResources
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

commands.description: PIM role activation outside normal working hours.
commands.command:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName contains "PIM" and OperationName contains "Activation"
| extend hour = hourofday(TimeGenerated)
| where hour < 6 or hour > 22
| project TimeGenerated, InitiatedBy, OperationName, TargetResources

commands.description: Service principal granted high-privilege API permissions.
commands.command:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName == "Add app role assignment to service principal"
| where TargetResources has_any ("Mail.ReadWrite","Directory.ReadWrite.All","RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory")
| project TimeGenerated, InitiatedBy, TargetResources
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

Hunt - Privileged Identity & Role Abuse.tuning: Tune alert thresholds based on your environment's baseline. Whitelist known legitimate tools and service accounts. Correlate with complementary Azure Sentinel data sources for context.

Hunt - Password Spraying & Brute Force.description: Proactively hunt for credential-based attacks against Azure AD accounts.

commands.description: Single IP failing authentication against many accounts in short window.
commands.command:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType in (50126, 50053, 50055, 50056)
| summarize failed_accounts = dcount(UserPrincipalName), count() by IPAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where failed_accounts > 10
| sort by failed_accounts desc

commands.description: Distributed password spray — many IPs failing against same account.
commands.command:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == 50126
| summarize unique_ips = dcount(IPAddress), count() by UserPrincipalName, bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| where unique_ips > 5
| sort by count_ desc

commands.description: Successful logon following multiple failures — successful brute.
commands.command:
let failures = SigninLogs | where ResultType != 0 | summarize fail_count = count() by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress;
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == 0
| join kind=inner failures on UserPrincipalName, IPAddress
| where fail_count > 5
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, fail_count

Hunt - Password Spraying & Brute Force.tuning: Tune detection thresholds against Azure Sentinel baseline auth failure rates. Exclude service accounts, health check endpoints, and known scanners. Alert on accounts hitting Smart Lockout first.

Hunt - Device Code & OAuth Phishing.description: Proactively hunt for device code flow abuse and illicit OAuth consent grants.

commands.description: Device code authentication flow used — potential phishing vector.
commands.command:
SigninLogs
| where AuthenticationProtocol == "deviceCode" or ClientAppUsed == "Device login flow"
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Location, AppDisplayName

commands.description: OAuth consent granted to application with dangerous permissions.
commands.command:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName == "Consent to application"
| where TargetResources has_any ("Mail.Read","Files.Read.All","Directory.Read.All","offline_access")
| project TimeGenerated, InitiatedBy, TargetResources

commands.description: New application registration with credentials added immediately.
commands.command:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName in ("Add application","Update application - Certificates and secrets management")
| summarize operations = make_set(OperationName), count() by tostring(InitiatedBy), bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1 and operations has "Add application"

Hunt - Device Code & OAuth Phishing.tuning: Tune alert thresholds based on your environment's baseline. Whitelist known legitimate tools and service accounts. Correlate with complementary Azure Sentinel data sources for context.

Hunt - Lateral Movement via SMB & RDP.description: Proactively hunt for internal lateral movement using Windows protocols.

commands.description: Single host connecting to many internal hosts over port 445 (SMB spread).
commands.command:
CommonSecurityLog
| where DestinationPort == 445 and DestinationIP matches regex "^(10\\.|172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\\.|192\\.168\\.)"
| summarize targets = dcount(DestinationIP) by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where targets > 15
| sort by targets desc

commands.description: RDP logon from an IP that has never connected before in past 30 days.
commands.command:
let known_rdp = SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) and EventID == 4624 and LogonType == 10
| summarize known_ips = make_set(IpAddress) by TargetUserName;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) and EventID == 4624 and LogonType == 10
| join kind=leftouter known_rdp on TargetUserName
| where IpAddress !in (known_ips)
| project TimeGenerated, TargetUserName, IpAddress, Computer

commands.description: WMI or WinRM remote execution to multiple hosts in 10 minutes.
commands.command:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4624 and LogonType in (3, 10)
| where Process in ("WmiPrvSE.exe","wsmprovhost.exe")
| summarize hosts = dcount(Computer) by Account, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where hosts > 3

Hunt - Lateral Movement via SMB & RDP.tuning: Baseline normal admin movement patterns in your environment before enabling alerting. Exclude DC replication traffic. Alert on first-seen lateral paths between host pairs.

Hunt - Data Exfiltration Indicators.description: Proactively hunt for large data transfers to external destinations in Microsoft 365 and Azure.

commands.description: Large SharePoint or OneDrive download volume by single user.
commands.command:
OfficeActivity
| where Operation in ("FileDownloaded","FileSyncDownloadedFull")
| summarize download_count = count(), sites = dcount(Site_Url) by UserId, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where download_count > 500
| sort by download_count desc

commands.description: Email forwarding rule created to external domain.
commands.command:
OfficeActivity
| where Operation == "Set-Mailbox" and Parameters has "ForwardingSmtpAddress"
| where Parameters !contains "@yourdomain.com"
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, Parameters

commands.description: Mass email deletion or purge — evidence destruction before exfil.
commands.command:
OfficeActivity
| where Operation in ("HardDelete","MoveToDeletedItems","Purge")
| summarize count() by UserId, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 200

commands.description: Sensitive file accessed then immediately shared externally.
commands.command:
OfficeActivity
| where Operation in ("FileAccessed","AnonymousLinkCreated","SharingInvitationCreated")
| where Operation == "AnonymousLinkCreated" or ExternalAccess == true
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, OfficeObjectId, Operation
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

Hunt - Data Exfiltration Indicators.tuning: Baseline normal data transfer volumes before alerting on exfiltration. Alert on transfers to new destinations. Tune DNS exfil detection on query entropy and subdomain count.

Hunt - Malicious Script Execution.description: Proactively hunt for PowerShell, VBScript, and script-based attacks via Defender for Endpoint telemetry.

commands.description: Encoded PowerShell execution from Office application.
commands.command:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("WINWORD.EXE","EXCEL.EXE","POWERPNT.EXE","OUTLOOK.EXE")
| where FileName == "powershell.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc","-EncodedCommand","-e ","IEX","DownloadString")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, ProcessCommandLine

commands.description: AMSI bypass pattern in PowerShell command line.
commands.command:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName == "powershell.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("AmsiUtils","amsiInitFailed","amsiContext","EtwEventWrite","PSEtwLogProvider")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine

commands.description: wscript or cscript executing file from temp or download directory.
commands.command:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Temp","Downloads","AppData","ProgramData")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine

Hunt - Malicious Script Execution.tuning: Alert on parent-child process anomalies (Office→shell, AcroRd32→cmd). Whitelist known deployment tools (SCCM, Intune). Tune Azure Sentinel alerts to reduce FPs from legitimate automation.

Hunt - Ransomware Pre-Staging.description: Proactively hunt for ransomware staging activities — shadow copy deletion, backup kills, and mass encryption.

commands.description: Volume shadow copy deletion via vssadmin or wmic.
commands.command:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","Delete Shadows","shadowcopy delete","resize shadowstorage")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine

commands.description: bcdedit disabling boot recovery — pre-ransomware indicator.
commands.command:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName == "bcdedit.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled No","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine

commands.description: Mass file rename across many files in short window — encryption underway.
commands.command:
DeviceFileEvents
| where ActionType == "FileRenamed"
| summarize renamed = count() by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| where renamed > 100
| sort by renamed desc

commands.description: Security tool or backup service terminated by process.
commands.command:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in~ ("taskkill.exe","net.exe","sc.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MSSQLServer","vss","backup","sophos","defender","avp","mbam")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine

Hunt - Ransomware Pre-Staging.tuning: Tune alert thresholds based on your environment's baseline. Whitelist known legitimate tools and service accounts. Correlate with complementary Azure Sentinel data sources for context.

Hunt - Suspicious Network Connections.description: Proactively hunt for connections to Tor, known bad IP ranges, and C2 infrastructure.

commands.description: Connection to known Tor exit node ports.
commands.command:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where RemotePort in (9001, 9030, 9050, 9051, 9150)
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteIP, RemotePort

commands.description: Process connecting outbound on non-standard high ports (not 80/443/8080).
commands.command:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where RemoteIPType == "Public" and RemotePort !in (80, 443, 8080, 8443, 53, 25, 110, 143)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("svchost.exe","lsass.exe","services.exe")
| summarize count() by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, RemotePort
| where count_ > 10
| sort by count_ desc

commands.description: Newly registered domain contacted for the first time (age < 30 days).
commands.command:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| join kind=inner (ThreatIntelligenceIndicator | where DomainName != "" and ExpirationDateTime > now()) on $left.RemoteUrl == $right.DomainName
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, InitiatingProcessFileName, ThreatType

Hunt - Suspicious Network Connections.tuning: Tune on internal traffic anomalies. Whitelist known scanners, monitoring agents, and backup systems. Alert on internal scanning from endpoints (not servers) as high priority.

Hunt - Persistence via Scheduled Tasks &.description: Proactively hunt for attacker persistence mechanisms using scheduled tasks and services.

commands.description: Scheduled task created referencing temp or user writable paths.
commands.command:
DeviceEvents
| where ActionType == "ScheduledTaskCreated"
| where AdditionalFields has_any ("Temp","AppData","ProgramData","Users","powershell","cmd.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, AdditionalFields

commands.description: New Windows service installed pointing to non-standard binary path.
commands.command:
DeviceEvents
| where ActionType == "ServiceInstalled"
| where AdditionalFields has_any ("Temp","Users","ProgramData","AppData")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, AdditionalFields

commands.description: Registry Run key modified by unexpected process.
commands.command:
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where RegistryKey has_any ("SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run","SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon")
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("msiexec.exe","setup.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, InitiatingProcessFileName

Hunt - Persistence via Scheduled Tasks &.tuning: Alert on persistence outside business hours or from unusual accounts. Whitelist software deployment mechanisms. Cross-reference with Azure Sentinel change management records.

commands.description: certutil used for download or decode — LOLBin abuse.
commands.command:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName == "certutil.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-urlcache","-decode","-encode","-decodehex","http")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine

commands.description: mshta executing remote or local script content.
commands.command:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName == "mshta.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http","javascript","vbscript","about:")

commands.description: regsvr32 scrobj.dll squiblydoo technique.
commands.command:

| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("scrobj.dll","http","/i:","/s")

commands.description: rundll32 calling suspicious exported functions.
commands.command:
DeviceProcessEvents

commands.description: IIS worker process spawning cmd or powershell.
commands.command:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName == "w3wp.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","net.exe","whoami.exe","ipconfig.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine

commands.description: File written to web root by server process.
commands.command:
DeviceFileEvents
| where FolderPath has_any ("inetpub","wwwroot","htdocs","www")
| where FileExtension in~ ("php","asp","aspx","jsp","cfm","ashx")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe")

Hunt - Webshell & Server Compromise.tuning: Tune alert thresholds based on your environment's baseline. Whitelist known legitimate tools and service accounts. Correlate with complementary Azure Sentinel data sources for context.

Hunt - Kerberos & AD Attacks.description: Proactively hunt for Kerberoasting, AS-REP roasting, and DCSync via Azure Defender for Identity.

commands.description: Kerberoasting — RC4 TGS request for service account (Event 4769).
commands.command:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4769 and TicketEncryptionType == "0x17"
| where ServiceName !endswith "$"
| summarize count() by IpAddress, TargetUserName, ServiceName
| where count_ > 3

commands.description: AS-REP roasting — pre-auth not required (Event 4768).
commands.command:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4768 and PreAuthType == "0"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetUserName, IpAddress

commands.description: DCSync — DS-Replication from non-DC account (Event 4662).
commands.command:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4662
| where Properties has_any ("1131f6aa","1131f6ad","89e95b76")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, Properties

commands.description: Password spraying across on-prem AD (Event 4625 spread).
commands.command:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4625 and LogonType == 3
| summarize unique_accounts = dcount(TargetUserName) by IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where unique_accounts > 10
| sort by unique_accounts desc

Hunt - Kerberos & AD Attacks.tuning: Whitelist legitimate Kerberos service accounts and scheduled tasks. Alert on RC4/DES downgrade requests for high-privilege SPNs. Cross-reference with Azure Sentinel identity logs.

commands.description: User accessing large number of unique files in SharePoint in 1 hour.

OfficeActivity

commands.description: Unusual USB or removable media activity from high-value user.

DeviceEvents
| where ActionType in ("UsbDriveMount","UsbDriveMounted","PnpDeviceConnected")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","SYSTEM")

commands.description: Airdrop or Bluetooth file transfer from monitored endpoint.
commands.command:
DeviceEvents
| where ActionType == "BluetoothPairingRequest" or (ActionType == "PnpDeviceConnected" and AdditionalFields has "Bluetooth")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, AdditionalFields

Hunt - Insider Threat & Data Staging.tuning: Tune alert thresholds based on your environment's baseline. Whitelist known legitimate tools and service accounts. Correlate with complementary Azure Sentinel data sources for context.

commands.description: New VM created and then immediately used for outbound connections.
commands.command:
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue == "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/write" and ActivityStatusValue == "Success"
| join kind=inner (AzureDiagnostics | where Category == "NetworkSecurityGroupFlowEvent" and Direction_s == "O") on $left.SubscriptionId == $right.SubscriptionId

commands.description: Storage account public access enabled.
commands.command:
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue has "storageAccounts" and Properties has "allowBlobPublicAccess"

commands.description: Network Security Group allowing inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 to admin ports.
commands.command:
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue == "Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/securityRules/write"
| where Properties has "0.0.0.0" and Properties has_any ("3389","22","5985","445")
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, Resource, Properties

Hunt - Azure Resource Abuse.tuning: Tune alert thresholds based on your environment's baseline. Whitelist known legitimate tools and service accounts. Correlate with complementary Azure Sentinel data sources for context.

commands.description: curl or wget piped to bash — download and execute on Linux VM.

DefenderIoTRawEvent
| union SecurityAlert
| where ActivityType == "CommandExecution"
| where CommandLine has_any ("curl","wget") and CommandLine has_any ("| bash","| sh","| python")

commands.description: Cron or systemd unit file created on Azure Linux VM.

| where SyslogMessage has_any ("CRON","systemctl enable","created")

commands.description: SSH authorized_keys modified — backdoor key planted.
commands.command:
AuditLogs_CL

| project TimeGenerated, HostName, SyslogMessage, ProcessName

Hunt - Linux & Cloud Workload Threats.tuning: Correlate Azure Sentinel API calls with identity and network context. Alert on API calls from unexpected geographic regions or source IPs. Whitelist legitimate automation and CI/CD pipelines.

commands.description: Certificate requested with subject alternative name for another user.

commands.description: Certipy or Certify tool execution on domain-joined host.

commands.description: Signed binary loading DLL from user-writable path (sideloading).

DeviceImageLoadEvents

commands.description: Binary executing from path that shadows a System32 DLL name.

commands.description: Application accessing mailbox of multiple users — BEC or stealer app.
commands.command:
OfficeActivity

commands.description: Refresh token used from new IP or country — token theft indicator.

commands.description: Driver loaded from user-writable path by non-system process — BYOVD staging signal.

commands.description: Known BYOVD hash or name from public vulnerability databases.

commands.description: Security product process termination shortly after driver load.

Hunt - Sysmon Full Coverage (Events 1,3,.description: Comprehensive Sysmon-based threat hunting via the WindowsEvent table (DCR ingestion) or Event table (MMA). Covers all key Sysmon event IDs: 1 (Process Create), 3 (Network), 6 (Driver Load/BYOVD), 7 (Image Load/DLL), 8 (CreateRemoteThread), 10 (ProcessAccess/LSASS), 11 (FileCreate), 13 (Registry), 15 (ADS), 17/18 (Named Pipe), 19/20/21 (WMI), 22 (DNS Query), 25 (Process Tamper).

commands.description: Sysmon 1 — Office/browser spawning LOLBin or shell (spearphish T1566, initial access).
commands.command:
WindowsEvent
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 1
| extend Image = tostring(EventData.Image), ParentImage = tostring(EventData.ParentImage), CommandLine = tostring(EventData.CommandLine)
| where ParentImage has_any ("WINWORD.EXE","EXCEL.EXE","POWERPNT.EXE","outlook.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","msedge.exe")
| where Image has_any ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","certutil.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Image, ParentImage, CommandLine

commands.description: Sysmon 1 — Process executed from writable staging path (T1204 user execution, dropper).
commands.command:
WindowsEvent
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 1
| extend Image = tostring(EventData.Image), User = tostring(EventData.User), Hashes = tostring(EventData.Hashes)
| where Image has_any ("\\Temp\\","\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\","\\ProgramData\\","\\Users\\Public\\")
| where not(Image has_any ("msiexec","setup","install"))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, User, Image, Hashes

commands.description: Sysmon 3 — Network connection initiated by scripting process to external IP (C2 T1071).
commands.command:
WindowsEvent
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 3
| extend Image = tostring(EventData.Image), DestIP = tostring(EventData.DestinationIp), DestPort = tostring(EventData.DestinationPort), Initiated = tostring(EventData.Initiated)
| where Initiated == "true"
| where Image has_any ("powershell","cmd.exe","wscript","cscript","mshta","certutil","bitsadmin","regsvr32","rundll32")
| where not(DestIP startswith "10." or DestIP startswith "172.16." or DestIP startswith "192.168." or DestIP == "127.0.0.1")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Image, DestIP, DestPort

commands.description: Sysmon 6 — Driver loaded from user-writable path — BYOVD (T1014, T1543.003).
commands.command:
WindowsEvent
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 6
| extend ImageLoaded = tostring(EventData.ImageLoaded), Signed = tostring(EventData.Signed), Signature = tostring(EventData.Signature)
| where ImageLoaded has_any ("\\Temp\\","\\AppData\\","\\ProgramData\\","\\Users\\Public\\")
   or ImageLoaded has_any ("gdrv.sys","dbutil_2_3.sys","rtcore64.sys","mhyprot2.sys","iqvw64e.sys","procexp152.sys","AsrDrv104.sys")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, ImageLoaded, Signed, Signature

commands.description: Sysmon 7 — DLL loaded from user-writable path by privileged process — DLL hijacking (T1574).
commands.command:
WindowsEvent
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 7
| extend Image = tostring(EventData.Image), ImageLoaded = tostring(EventData.ImageLoaded), Signed = tostring(EventData.Signed)
| where ImageLoaded has_any ("\\Temp\\","\\Users\\","\\ProgramData\\")
| where Image has_any ("lsass.exe","svchost.exe","winlogon.exe","explorer.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Image, ImageLoaded, Signed

commands.description: Sysmon 8 — CreateRemoteThread injection into LSASS or security processes (T1055).
commands.command:
WindowsEvent
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 8
| extend SourceImage = tostring(EventData.SourceImage), TargetImage = tostring(EventData.TargetImage), StartFunction = tostring(EventData.StartFunction)
| where TargetImage has_any ("lsass.exe","svchost.exe","csrss.exe","winlogon.exe","MsMpEng.exe","SentinelAgent.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SourceImage, TargetImage, StartFunction

commands.description: Sysmon 10 — ProcessAccess to LSASS by unexpected process — credential dumping (T1003.001).
commands.command:
WindowsEvent
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 10
| extend SourceImage = tostring(EventData.SourceImage), TargetImage = tostring(EventData.TargetImage), GrantedAccess = tostring(EventData.GrantedAccess)
| where TargetImage has "lsass.exe"
| where not(SourceImage has_any ("svchost.exe","csrss.exe","werfault.exe","wmiprvse.exe"))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SourceImage, TargetImage, GrantedAccess

commands.description: Sysmon 11 — Executable or script dropped to temp/appdata path (T1105 ingress tool transfer).
commands.command:
WindowsEvent
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 11
| extend TargetFilename = tostring(EventData.TargetFilename), Image = tostring(EventData.Image)
| where TargetFilename has_any ("\\Temp\\","\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\","\\ProgramData\\","\\Users\\Public\\")
| where TargetFilename has_any (".exe",".dll",".bat",".ps1",".vbs",".hta",".js",".scr")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Image, TargetFilename

commands.description: Sysmon 13 — Registry persistence key set (Run/RunOnce, IFEO, AppInit, T1547/T1546).
commands.command:
WindowsEvent
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 13
| extend TargetObject = tostring(EventData.TargetObject), Details = tostring(EventData.Details), Image = tostring(EventData.Image)
| where TargetObject has_any ("\\Run\\","\\RunOnce\\","Image File Execution Options","AppInit_DLLs","Security Packages","Winlogon\\Shell","Winlogon\\Userinit")
| where not(Image has_any ("msiexec","TrustedInstaller","setup"))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Image, TargetObject, Details

commands.description: Sysmon 15 — Alternate Data Stream (ADS) write — NTFS stream payload hiding (T1564.004).
commands.command:
WindowsEvent
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 15
| extend TargetFilename = tostring(EventData.TargetFilename), Hash = tostring(EventData.Hash)
| where TargetFilename contains ":" and not(TargetFilename endswith ":Zone.Identifier" or TargetFilename has ":AFP_")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetFilename, Hash

commands.description: Sysmon 17 — Named pipe created matching Cobalt Strike default names (T1071, T1573).
commands.command:
WindowsEvent
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 17
| extend PipeName = tostring(EventData.PipeName), Image = tostring(EventData.Image)
| where PipeName has_any ("postex_","msagent_","MSSE-","mojo.","status_","IEFrame","scerpc_priv")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Image, PipeName

commands.description: Sysmon 18 — Named pipe connected from unexpected process — inter-process C2 channel.
commands.command:
WindowsEvent
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 18
| extend PipeName = tostring(EventData.PipeName), Image = tostring(EventData.Image)
| where not(Image has_any ("svchost","lsass","chrome","firefox","msedge","explorer","spoolsv"))
| where not(PipeName has_any ("wkssvc","srvsvc","netlogon","lsarpc","samr","winreg"))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Image, PipeName

commands.description: Sysmon 19/20/21 — WMI subscription persistence triplet registered (T1546.003).
commands.command:
WindowsEvent
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID in (19,20,21)
| extend EventType = case(EventID==19,"FilterCreated",EventID==20,"ConsumerCreated","BindingCreated")
| extend Name = tostring(EventData.Name), User = tostring(EventData.User)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, EventType, Name, User
| order by TimeGenerated asc

commands.description: Sysmon 22 — DNS query by scripting process for non-Microsoft domain — C2 or DGA (T1071.004).
commands.command:
WindowsEvent
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 22
| extend QueryName = tostring(EventData.QueryName), Image = tostring(EventData.Image)
| where Image has_any ("powershell","cmd.exe","wscript","cscript","mshta","certutil","rundll32")
| where not(QueryName has_any ("microsoft.com","windows.com","office.com","live.com","windowsupdate.com","azure.com"))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Image, QueryName

commands.description: Sysmon 25 — Process tampering/hollowing — image section replaced in memory (T1055.012).
commands.command:
WindowsEvent
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 25
| extend Image = tostring(EventData.Image), Type = tostring(EventData.Type)
| where not(Image has_any ("MpCopyAccelerator","MsMpEng","msiexec"))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Image, Type

Hunt - RBCD & Resource-Based Delegation.description: Hunt for Resource-Based Constrained Delegation (RBCD) attack setup — msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity attribute writes, machine account creation chains, and S4U2Proxy ticket anomalies.

commands.description: Hunt for msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity attribute modification (Event 5136)
commands.command:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 5136
| extend AttrName = tostring(EventData.AttributeLDAPDisplayName)
| where AttrName == 'msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity'
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Actor=tostring(EventData.SubjectUserName), TargetObject=tostring(EventData.ObjectDN), Operation=tostring(EventData.OperationType)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

commands.description: Hunt for machine account creation + RBCD attribute write within 30 minutes (attack chain)
commands.command:
let MachineCreation = SecurityEvent
    | where EventID == 4741
    | project CreationTime=TimeGenerated, Creator=tostring(EventData.SubjectUserName), NewMachine=tostring(EventData.TargetUserName);
let RBCDWrite = SecurityEvent
    | where EventID == 5136
    | where tostring(EventData.AttributeLDAPDisplayName) == 'msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity'
    | project WriteTime=TimeGenerated, Writer=tostring(EventData.SubjectUserName);
MachineCreation
| join kind=inner RBCDWrite on $left.Creator == $right.Writer
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', CreationTime, WriteTime)) <= 30
| project CreationTime, WriteTime, Creator, NewMachine

commands.description: Hunt for S4U2Proxy Kerberos service tickets with forwardable flag (Event 4769 — Ticket Options 0x20000)
commands.command:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4769
| extend TicketOpts = tostring(EventData.TicketOptions), ServiceName = tostring(EventData.ServiceName)
| where TicketOpts == '0x20000' and ServiceName !endswith '$' and ServiceName != 'krbtgt'
| summarize Count=count() by AccountName=tostring(EventData.TargetUserName), ServiceName, IpAddress=tostring(EventData.IpAddress)
| where Count > 3
| order by Count desc

commands.description: Hunt for low-privilege user modifying RBCD on high-value targets (DC or file server)
commands.command:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 5136
| where tostring(EventData.AttributeLDAPDisplayName) == 'msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity'
| where tostring(EventData.ObjectDN) contains 'OU=Domain Controllers' or tostring(EventData.ObjectDN) contains 'OU=Servers'
| project TimeGenerated, Actor=tostring(EventData.SubjectUserName), Target=tostring(EventData.ObjectDN)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
